title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ introduces noise to the model. Consider how noise affects the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Effect on Bias
text: Bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem with a simplified model. Think about whether adding random noise makes the model more or less simplified.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Variance refers to the model's sensitivity to fluctuations in the training data. Consider how adding random noise might affect this sensitivity.

title: Analyzing Bias
text: Does adding random noise make the model more complex or more simplified?

title: Analyzing Variance
text: Does adding random noise increase or decrease the model's sensitivity to the training data?
